exampleAnswers.title: Finding the Volume of a Cylinder

question.text: Calculate the volume of a cylinder given that its diameter is $34 \,\textrm{m}$ and its height is $11\, \textrm{m}.$
question.explanation:
The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by \[ V = \pi r^2h . \]

Substituting $r=\dfrac{34}{2} = 17\,\textrm{m}$ and $h=11\,\textrm{m}$ into the formula, we get \[ V = \pi(17 )^2(11 ) = 3\,179\pi\,\text{m}^3 . \]

question.text: Calculate the volume of a cylinder given that the circumference of the base is $14\pi \, \textrm{m}$ and the ratio of its height to its radius is $\dfrac{1}{49}.$
question.explanation:
First, we find the radius $r$ using the formula $C=2\pi r,$ where $C$ is the circumference, as follows:

\begin{align*} C &= 2\pi r \\[3pt] 14\pi &= 2\pi r \\[3pt] r &= 7\,\textrm{m} \end{align*}

To find the height $h$, we use the fact that the ratio of the height to the radius is $\dfrac{1}{49}\mathbin{:}$ \begin{align} \dfrac{h}{r} &= \dfrac{1}{49} \\[5pt] \dfrac{h}{7} &= \dfrac{1}{49} \\[5pt] h &= \dfrac{1}{7} \, \textrm{m} \end{align}

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by

\[ V=\pi r^2 h. \]

Substituting $r=7\,\textrm{m}$ and $h=\dfrac{1}{7} \,\textrm{m}$ into the formula, we get

\[ V = \pi \cdot 7^2\cdot \dfrac{1}{7} = 7\pi\, \textrm{m}^3. \]

question.text: Calculate the volume of a cylinder given that its diameter is $10\,\textrm{in}$ and its height is $8\,\textrm{in}.$
question.explanation:
The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by

\[ V = \pi r^2h . \]

Substituting $r=\dfrac{10}{2} = 5\,\textrm{in}$ and $h=8\,\textrm{in}$ into the formula, we get

\[ V = \pi (5)^2( 8) = 200\pi\,\textrm{in}^3 . \]

exampleAnswers.title: Finding a Dimension of a Cylinder Given Its Volume

question.text: Calculate the height $h$ of a cylinder given that its volume is $16\pi \,\textrm{cm}^3$ and the ratio of its height to its radius is $2.$
question.explanation:
Using the fact that the ratio of the height $h$ to the radius of the base $r$ is $2,$ we have that \begin{align} \dfrac{h}{r} &= 2\\[5pt] r &= \dfrac{h}{2} \end{align}

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by \[ \eqalign{ V = \pi r^2h . } \]

Substituting $V=16\pi \textrm{ cm}^3$ and $r=\dfrac{h}{2}$ into the formula, we find the value of $h \mathbin{:}$ \begin{align} V & = \pi r^2h\\[5pt] 16\pi &= \pi \left( \dfrac{h}{2} \right)^2\cdot h \\[5pt] 16 &= \dfrac{h^3}{4}\\[5pt] h^3 &= 64\\[5pt] h & = 4 \, \textrm{cm}. \end{align}

example.title: Finding a Dimension of a Cylinder Given Its Volume

question.text: Calculate the circumference of the base of a cylinder given that its volume is $1\,536\pi \,\textrm{cm}^3$ and the ratio of its radius to its height is $\dfrac{1}{3}.$
question.explanation:
Using the fact that the ratio of the radius $r$ of the base to the height $h$ is $\dfrac{1}{3},$ we have that \begin{align} \dfrac{r}{h} &= \dfrac{1}{3} \\[5pt] h &= 3r \end{align}

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by

\[ V=\pi r^2 h. \]

Substituting $V=1\,536\pi\,\textrm{cm}^3$ and $h=3r$ into the formula, we can find the value of $r\mathbin{:}$

\[ \begin{align*} V&= \pi r^2 h\\[3pt] 1\,536\pi&= \pi r^2 \left(3r\right)\\[3pt] 1\,536&= 3r^3\\[3pt] r^3&= 512\\[3pt] r&= \sqrt[3]{512}\\[3pt] r&= 8\,\textrm{cm}. \end{align*} \]

Finally, the formula for the circumference of the base is $C=2\pi r.$ So, we have

\[ C=16\pi \,\textrm{cm}.\]

exampleAnswers.title: Finding an Expression for a Dimension of a Cylinder Given a Proportion

question.text: Find an expression for the volume $V$ of a cylinder in terms of $h$ given that $\dfrac{r}{h} = 5,$ where $r$ is the radius of the base and $h$ is the height of the cylinder.
question.explanation:
Our goal is to express $V$ in terms of $h.$ Therefore, we need to isolate $r$ in the above equation: \begin{align*} \dfrac{r}{h} & = 5\\[5pt] r & = 5h \end{align*}

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by \[ V = \pi r^2h . \]

Therefore, substituting $r=5h$ into the formula, we get \begin{align} V & = \pi r^2h\\[5pt] & = \pi (5h)^2 \cdot h \\[5pt] & = \pi \cdot 25h^2 \cdot h \\[5pt] & = 25 \pi h^3. \end{align}

example.title: Finding an Expression for a Dimension of a Cylinder Given a Proportion

question.text: Find an expression for the volume $V$ of a cylinder in terms of its height $h,$ given that the ratio of the radius of the base to the height of the cylinder is $8.$
question.explanation:
Using the fact that the ratio of the radius $r$ of the base to the height $h$ is $8,$ we have that \[ \dfrac{r}{h} = 8. \]

Our goal is to express $V$ in terms of $h.$ Therefore, we need to isolate $r$ in the above equation: \begin{align} \dfrac{r}{h} & = 8\\[5pt] r & = 8h \end{align}

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by \[ V = \pi r^2h . \]

Therefore, substituting $r = 8h$ into the formula, we get \begin{align} V & = \pi r^2 h \\[5pt] & = \pi (8h)^2 \cdot h \\[5pt] & = \pi \cdot 64h^2 \cdot h \\[5pt] & = 64 \pi h^3. \end{align}
